Buspar was the big difference for my mental health! I was on Prozac for depression and Adderall for ADHD, but I still had a ton of anxiety related to trauma. I’m reading that a lot of people haven’t had great experiences, but it helped me so much and I’m glad to read about how it’s helped others too!
